title: Retro Christmas / Printable Stickers Cr
author: HelgaKOV
description:
I am pleased to present you my collection.
This collection: Retro Christmas   stickers, includes 21 stickers are perfect for your planner, laptop stickers, scrapbooking, card making, decoration and many more projects.
You will receive:
1.   Folder CRICUT_SILHOUETTE – Included ready to print 2 files PNG/JPG with all stickers and 1 PNG file with silhouettes for Silhouette Studio
2.   Folder HAND CUT – Included ready to print 2 files PNG/JPG, all stickers with hand cut lines
3.   Folder INDIVIDUALLY – including all 21 stickers individually PNG/JPG  (files with transparent background 300 dpi)
4.   Folder VECTOR – Included 1 EPS and 1 AI files. Easy to edit and resize
** This is a digital file and no physical item will be shipped **
Thanks for stopping by!
